# Instructions for this generated public repository

This repository is a deployment mirror. Do not edit website content here.

- The only editable source of truth is `1337816143/My-Evolution`.
- Redirect every requested page, content, styling, data, prompt, report, or asset change to that private repository.
- In `My-Evolution`, read `AGENTS.md`, classify website versus private material, run `npm ci && npm test`, and commit there.
- The private repository's `publish.yml` saves the complete site snapshot and mirrors it here automatically, with a 15-minute scheduled fallback.
- Never create unique content in this repository; it will be deleted by the next mirror.
- Never copy private materials, raw notes, credentials, secrets, or the private repository root here.
- Do not replace the complete career report with an abbreviated version.
- Prompt additions and edits must update `08-ai-digital-systems/prompts/library/` or use `.github/workflows/prompt-upsert.yml` in the private repository. Never hand-edit generated `data/prompts.json` here.
- Relationship pages must follow the encrypted/public-summary rules from the private repository; never publish upstream plaintext relationship data.

If you cannot access `My-Evolution`, do not modify this repository. Tell the user that the source repository must be updated instead.
